prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in the Software Engineering and Software Practicum modules are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to utilize in-depth programming knowledge in working on a larger software development task through all project phases.
Work in a team and structure a project under guidance according to project management principles.
Present and communicate work and project results.

syllabus_topics: Testing and integration of a larger software system
Quality assurance and documentation of the system
Presentation of interim and final results
teaching_methods: Independent study and execution of the given software development task
Introduction and continuous supervision by a professor or staff member of the department

assessment_methods.method: Software creation (the term software includes all created artifacts, especially program code, planning documents, user and developer manuals, and presentation material)

assessment_rules: The module is ungraded according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science program.
